answered_questions.vertical_state_information: Within the bounded B01 cohort, L3 is the minimum tested predictive-state-information candidate. Additional explicit lower-zone storages did not demonstrate additional future-response information there.
answered_questions.layer_placement: Uniform placement is not supported as a default. Localized lower-zone resolution is repeatedly more informative for propagation fidelity, and the equal-dimension L3+global-moment route did not replace L4.
answered_questions.closure: The tested storage-only and first-global-moment closures do not make L3 broadly adequate. Standard Layer-ROM/LARE closure fidelity improves strongly with localized resolution.
answered_questions.purpose: GW-R/GW-D and SCI-P have visibly different fidelity burdens. AG-WB and EVT remain outside the present no-sink/no-event envelope.
answered_questions.computation: L4/L6/R8 all show a preregistered robust shared-host CPU-reduction signal versus R16 on all six fixed-head transfer materials, including the fourfold-refined timing bracket.

retained_frontier.caveat: material-dependent; CoRichards componentwise no-worse on B02/B05/B06
stronger across panel; B05 remains CoRichards-no-worse
placement support on all six materials; B05 remains groundwater tradeoff

rejected_or_held: L3 as a generally adequate propagated Layer-ROM
one global first moment as replacement for localized fourth storage
empirical closure correction without new physical authority
application acceptance without independent purpose tolerances

current_blocker.description: The evidence now supports a cost-effective representation frontier, but choosing a sufficient member for GW-R, GW-D or SCI-P requires independently sourced purpose-specific tolerances and temporal-allocation semantics. Current repository evidence explicitly does not provide those absolute application thresholds.
current_blocker.consequence: Further lowering or selecting dimension from the present research errors would be post-hoc application acceptance.
resolution_options: Bind external GW-R recharge/water-balance tolerances and temporal aggregation rules.
Bind external GW-D head/exchange/reversal tolerances and temporal allocation rules.
Bind SCI-P profile/process tolerances if profile research is the target.
Open separate AG-WB/EVT authority only after ET/root-uptake or event physics are authorized.

next_safe_step: Choose and source an independent purpose-specific acceptance envelope, then perform blind application-envelope validation on the frozen L4/L6/R8 frontier. Do not retune partitions or closures from those validation responses.
